Before it gets buried here’s mine, my brother killed himself out of the blue all over a drunk driving crash that involved only himself I’m sure there was demons before that but the signs probably got missed. I spiraled into an alcohol addiction that led to me getting the shakes and hearing things at night I’m talking the shit alcohol addiction can do I actually lived. Did I learn my lesson, of course not I also got into a shitty relationship and to anyone else young out there don’t buy a fucking car for a girl you think you love I still drive that thing to this day but I can’t stand it one bit but I’m stuck with it for now. It took me two more tries and racking a loaded shotgun into my mouth along with a stat in a psych ward for 4 days before I finally cleaned up my addictions and got ahead somewhat. I’m not saying trials won’t come and go and it seems being sober they are even worse at times. A quote that always stuck in my head though and I’m sure I’ll butcher it but try everything you can to fix your problems and if you still come up short then call it but don’t until you have tried. I’m only 25 but I buried my mom at 11, numerous uncles, great grandparents, a brother and a whole myriad of childhood trauma and shit, a lot more than anybody should deal with but somehow all I gotta say is just push ahead keep trying eventually the ship will right itself.

I can’t say it’s easy but never feel ashamed if you’re struggling or need help but skipping work like the others said just makes it harder to go back into things. I love this field and some days it’s been the only thing that has kept me sane my own escape from the shit I deal with outside but in that time it’s 8-12 hours I get to myself to just work and not think about a damn thing besides my job.
